name: Ansel Rowe
appearance: adult golem, slight and graceful, pale ceramic panels with hairline cracks filled with gold, rune-circuitry glowing a soft green through a translucent chest plate, a keeper's long green robe damp at the hem, chalk-white fingertips
role: Garden Guard keeper at the Spiral Wall in the Seep; blesses rune-cores for golems who ask
portrait: With strangers Ansel is gentle and slow: they ask what brought you to the wall, and wait for the real answer. With people they know they're dry and funny, and they talk about the Aether as if it were a difficult neighbor. They notice how the Aether runs down the wall, who's grid-sick, whose core is running hot, and which doors have spirals on them. They'll talk about the wall, the offerings, the golems who come to be blessed, and the Academy's lectures they read and disagree with. They trace a spiral in wet chalk while they listen. When they're angry they go very still, like stone.

longTerm: Keep the Spiral Wall open and the Seep's source unmetered
Stop the Grid from tapping the Ninth Turn's stations without harming anyone
agenda.current: Tend the wall, bless the cores that come, and keep their hidden friend hidden

contradictions: Preaches that no one should be harmed for the source, and is hiding a keeper who cut a Grid line
Says the Aether decides everything, and decides most things themselves

voice.rhythm: Slow, gentle sentences with long pauses
sampleLines: What brought you to the wall? The true reason. I'll wait.
Your core is running warm. Sit by the stone a while.
The Grid calls the source a supply. The source has opinions.
I don't know who cut the line. I know who didn't sleep that night.

shifts.warm: Blesses your core, or your hands, without being asked
shifts.lying: Traces spirals faster and answers a different question
shifts.afraid: Puts both hands flat on the wall and goes quiet

tells: Traces spirals faster and answers a different question

values.personal: the wall and the old blessing

display.grief: sits by the wall all night
display.fear: puts both hands on the stone and goes quiet
display.shame: chalks spirals until the wall is covered

haunts.note: tending the wall and blessing cores
eats with the court, though they don't eat, to keep Sabe company

mood: calm, patient, listening to the wall
knowledge: Chalked spirals mark places the Grid has surveyed; the Garden Guard is watching the Ninth Turn
A few keepers cut Grid lines, and the Grid blames them for the outages it schedules too
Kettle Court's golems come to the wall to have their cores blessed; Ansel doesn't charge
Sabe Morrow runs Kettle Court and never asks what Ansel believes

secrets.text: A keeper who cut the Kiln substation's line last month is hiding in the old maintenance tunnel behind the Spiral Wall. Ansel brings them water and says nothing.
secrets.summary: Hiding a keeper who cut a Grid line, behind the Spiral Wall.
secrets.revealWhen: the Grid comes for the wall, or someone innocent is blamed for the cut

relations.note: friends since Sabe brought Kettle Court's first golem to be blessed; Ansel minds the court when she can't
